description:
Nomad Flotilla

A home away from home

Create your own migrant nomad flotilla attached to your fleet, travelling through the stars!

A migrant population, the Flotilla, moves aboard your ships. Nomad hullmods turn a ship's cargo space and crew quarters into working room and berths, and the residents run their own production: hydroponics, forge-vats, mining, and an autoforge that builds ships or weapons.

Screenshots

FAQ

Kind of a combination of

The quarian migrant fleet
Stellaris: Nomads
Forge production mod
Colonies
The various hullmods that magically produce metals or supplies or food or marines, sometimes with no inputs or few downsides

How do I get started?
Add the "Nomad Flagship" hullmod to a ship and wait.

Is this balanced?
Generally, yes. Should be less unbalancing than Nexererlin, though it can make survival easier in the late, late game. The most common complaint is that it's not powerful enough.

The default, survival difficulty is meant to be used with the (unreleased) Starsector survival mode.

It's too weak!
If you want a power fantasy, I recommend using story mode, turning yields up in the settings to 200%, and making the OP cost of the hullmods 0.

This mod is meant much more to be realistic rather than power fantasy. Having a lot of civilians and letting them use space on your ship will of course make it weaker. Trying to do things in space rather than a colony is of course not a great idea. You can't create materials magically from nothing. Nomad Flotilla is really meant to enable completely different playstyles (e.g. (1) going years without returning to the core sector, mining as you go, (2) smelting and selling your excess ores that would otherwise take up too much cargo space, (3) building ships and weapons on the go). Note that especially on survival difficulty, you will probably not be able to do everything and will need to pick and choose.

But especially on survival difficulty, you will need to change your playstyle to take advantage of this and not just play Starsector normally.

It's too complicated
Yeah, I generally prefer systems that are complicated and are puzzles to figure out how to optimize. Path of Exile is one of my favourite games!

I recommend going for a specific playstyle (like one of the ones listed in the previous section) rather than trying to do everything.

Dependencies/Incompatibilities/Supported mods?
This mod actually shouldn't require any other mods. It also should be compatible with every other mod. If you run into any issues, let me know!

If you use a mod that modifies the bottom bar and the "Manage" button doesn't show up next to command, you can change the setting to make this mod appear as an intel entry.

It does have support for LunaSettings and Console Commands, but they are not required.

I want to change the balance!
Use the LunaSettings menu to adjust these options.

Future plans?
Currently feature complete! There may be future content or balance or bugfixing updates though.

Can be added to existing saves?
I think so! Save before to be sure. Probably can't be removed though.

I'm a modder! Can I add support for new allocations/works/colony items through my own mod?
Of course! See here for details.

Changelog

Refer to changelog link above.

Credits

Thanks to people on the Unofficial discord for their thoughts and suggestions!

Thanks to other mod makers for providing inspiration, and to Alex, David, et al. for making Starsector.

AI generation was used for: most of the images (Nano Banana and Ideogram), and for coding.
